world.description: a pencil logistics and supply network

world.label: Pencil Supply Network
world.summary: Specialists produce, move, and sell pencils using a renewing supply of wood and graphite ore.

actions.description: Cut logs from the managed forest.
Move logs from the timber crew to the sawmill worker.
Process the sawmill worker's logs into boards at the sawmill.
Move boards from the sawmill to the pencil maker.
Collect graphite ore from the deposit.
Move graphite ore from the miner to the refinery worker.
Process the refinery worker's graphite ore into graphite at the refinery.
Move graphite from the refinery to the pencil maker.
Assemble pencils from boards and graphite at the factory.
Move pencils from the factory to the delivery driver.
Move the delivery driver's pencils to the shop.
Sell pencils from the shop to a customer.
Add pencils to the shop's waiting order count.

mechanics.rationale: The timber crew cuts logs from a managed forest; the action transfers one log to its inventory.
limits: One log is cut per action; this does not represent regrowth.
tests: With a matching crew and a forest holding logs, one log moves to the crew.
A source without logs refuses the action.

mechanics.rationale: The timber crew transfers one log to the named sawmill worker.
limits: Moves one log per action; no other goods move.
tests: A crew with a log transfers one to a matching sawmill worker.
No transfer occurs when the crew has no logs.

mechanics.rationale: The sawmill worker consumes one log and produces one board at the named sawmill.

checks.label: the worker turns logs into boards

limits: Consumes one worker-held log and makes one board at the named workstation.
tests: A worker holding a log produces one board at the named mill.
A worker without logs cannot produce a board.

mechanics.rationale: The named source transfers one board to the named pencil maker.
limits: Moves one board per action.
tests: A source with a board transfers one to a matching pencil maker.
A source without boards refuses transfer.

mechanics.rationale: The graphite miner collects one ore from the named deposit.
limits: Collects one ore per action; this does not represent replenishment.
tests: A matching miner collects one ore when the deposit has ore.
An empty deposit refuses collection.

mechanics.rationale: The graphite miner transfers one ore to the named refinery worker.
limits: Moves one ore per action.
tests: A miner with ore transfers one to a matching refinery worker.
A miner without ore cannot transfer ore.

mechanics.rationale: The refinery worker consumes one ore and produces one graphite at the named refinery.
limits: Consumes one worker-held ore and makes one graphite at the named workstation.
tests: A worker holding ore produces one graphite at the named refinery.
A worker without ore cannot refine graphite.

mechanics.rationale: The named source transfers one graphite to the named pencil maker.
limits: Moves one graphite per action.
tests: A source with graphite transfers one to a matching pencil maker.
A source without graphite refuses transfer.

mechanics.rationale: The pencil maker consumes one board and one graphite to produce one pencil at the named factory.
limits: Consumes one board and one graphite to produce one pencil at the named factory.
tests: With both inputs, the worker produces one pencil at the factory.
Missing either input prevents assembly.

mechanics.rationale: The named source transfers one pencil to the named delivery driver.
limits: Moves one pencil per action.
tests: A factory with a pencil transfers one to a matching driver.
A factory without pencils refuses transfer.

mechanics.rationale: The delivery driver transfers one pencil to the named shop.
limits: Moves one pencil per action; it does not resolve shop orders.
tests: A driver with a pencil transfers one to the named shop.
A driver without pencils cannot deliver.

mechanics.rationale: The shopkeeper transfers one shop pencil to the customer.
limits: Sells one pencil per action; no payment state is represented.
tests: A shop with a pencil transfers one to the named customer.
A shop without pencils cannot sell one.

mechanics.rationale: The shopkeeper adds the requested nonnegative quantity to the named shop's waiting pencil count.

checks.label: the order quantity is within the supported range

limits: Accepts integer quantities from 1 through 8; no other order details are represented.
tests: A supported positive quantity increases the named shop's waiting count by that amount.
Zero, negative, or greater-than-eight quantities are refused.
semantic_bindings: quantity is the number of pencils ordered

processes.rationale: The managed forest renews a small supply of logs each round, supporting continuing timber production without creating processed goods.

checks.label: the forest is below its represented stock cap

processes.rationale: The deposit renews a small supply of ore each round, supporting continuing mining without creating processed goods.

checks.label: the deposit is below its represented stock cap

processes.rationale: Customers continue to want pencils, so the shop's waiting order count replenishes each round.

readout.title: How goods moved through the chain
readout.summary: The graphite miner mined ore, the refinery worker turned ore into graphite, and the carrier moved graphite to the pencil maker. The shopkeeper’s pencil orders kept growing, but no pencils were made or delivered to the shop in the recorded events.

mechanisms.name: Goods made from other goods
mechanisms.explanation: The refinery worker used graphite ore to make graphite, consuming the ore in the process.

mechanisms.name: Goods carried to the next step
mechanisms.explanation: The graphite miner moved ore to the refinery worker, and the carrier moved graphite from the refinery to the pencil maker.

mechanisms.name: Demand reached and met
mechanisms.missing_reason: No finished goods were delivered to or used at the place wanting them.

mechanisms.name: Work held up
mechanisms.missing_reason: No recorded work was held up because needed goods had not arrived or had run out.
